clippings.speaker: Willem Dafoe
clippings.quote: Robert had so much stuff to give me and he pretty much turned me on to everything I needed
clippings.title: Robert Eggers and Willem Dafoe on The Lighthouse
clippings.context: Joint London interview; Dafoe on how Eggers's period research fed his preparation for Thomas Wake.

clippings.speaker: Robert Eggers
clippings.quote: It builds your confidence when Willem Dafoe sees The Witch and his team contacts you for a meeting and says 'I want to be in whatever you're doing next'
clippings.title: Robert Eggers and Willem Dafoe on The Lighthouse
clippings.context: Eggers recalls how their collaboration began after Dafoe saw The Witch.

clippings.speaker: Robert Eggers
clippings.quote: Dafoe comes from the theater, and has more energy than my one-year-old son. He can bring it all fucking day long in rehearsals and then go 25-percent more when we're shooting.
clippings.title: Drunken Sailors and Movie Stars: Robert Eggers on Making 'The Lighthouse'
clippings.context: Eggers on rehearsing The Lighthouse with Dafoe and Robert Pattinson.

clippings.speaker: Willem Dafoe
clippings.quote: I thought that this guy's the full package. I mean, besides seeing "The Witch," you get this beautiful script, you get this beautiful set to work in and the shots are constructed so beautifully.
clippings.title: Before 'Nosferatu,' Robert Eggers Recalls Almost Getting Willem Dafoe Set on Fire
clippings.context: Joint Nosferatu interview; Dafoe looks back on their first collaboration.

clippings.speaker: Robert Eggers
clippings.quote: Why wouldn't you want to continue to work with one of the greatest actors of all time?
clippings.title: Before 'Nosferatu,' Robert Eggers Recalls Almost Getting Willem Dafoe Set on Fire
clippings.context: Asked whether The Lighthouse felt like the start of a long partnership.

clippings.speaker: Willem Dafoe
clippings.quote: I want to try to be that guy that he thinks I am. But it's a mutual respect and he inspires me terrifically. And not just his way of working and what he does, but his character, where creating this stuff fits into his life.
clippings.title: Before 'Nosferatu,' Robert Eggers Recalls Almost Getting Willem Dafoe Set on Fire
clippings.context: Dafoe responding to Eggers calling him one of the greatest actors of all time.

clippings.speaker: Robert Eggers
clippings.quote: Different actors need different things. I know what Willem needs. And I knew that some people needed a more complete backstory for the kind of work that they do to get into the character.
clippings.title: Before 'Nosferatu,' Robert Eggers Recalls Almost Getting Willem Dafoe Set on Fire
clippings.context: On why he didn't share his Nosferatu backstory novella with Dafoe.

notes: Seattle Times AP Q&A returned 403 and Washington Times copy was bot-blocked; TheWrap joint interview was the richest source.
